project.name: coverage-fixture
project.summary: A curated miniature repository used to verify discovery evidence without inventing application behavior.
project.thesis: This fixture is best read through the evidence surfaces it exposes to the scanner, not as an ordered runtime product.

nodes.label: Python Worker Surface
nodes.description: Provides an imported provider and a local module relationship for scanner evidence.

nodes.label: Package Declarations

nodes.inspector_summary: Package metadata is direct configuration evidence, not inferred runtime behavior.

nodes.label: Recorded Status Sample

projection_candidates.label: Provider Boundary
projection_candidates.question_answered: Which external provider might this fixture mention?
